snippet.title: Castle Invasion: Throne Out - Xbox One Gameplay
snippet.description:
The king is not a nice gent. He's given you an ultimatum. Surrender your castle or be throne out. (See what I did there? Because the king sits on a throne. . .yeah? . . . never mind.) With an army of misfits at his beck and call, you'd better pick up that bow and arrow and settle in for some crown duels.

Castle Invasion is the fun, frantic challenge of defending your castle against an army.

Developed and published by Cat Trap Studios
Also released on Steam, PlayStation 4, PlayStation Vita and Nintendo Switch

#xbox #xboxone #indiegames #idatxbox #theforeseenarcade #cattrapstudios #castleinvasion #castleinvasionthroneout

FUN FACT: Before making this game, Cat Trap Studios developed Mouse Bounce, which was released for PlayStation Vita and Android through PlayStation Mobile, Sony's long-forgotten answer to Xbox Live Indie Games for portable titles. At one point, it was going to introduce an update for developers to add PSN Trophy support, but those plans were scrapped due to the shutdown of PS Mobile, leading to all games made for it becoming lost media.
